How to play

8 7 4 5 1 7

Three rules. That is all.

  1. 1Same number, or two that make 10.
  2. 2Joined by a straight path across, down, or diagonally.
  3. 3Or the end of a row to the start of the next.

Either way, nothing may be left standing in between.

Tap two tiles showing the same number.

…or two tiles that add up to 10.

The two tiles must sit on a straight line. Any of the 8 directions works.

…or be neighbors in reading order. The end of a row wraps to the start of the next.

Empty a whole row and it collapses. Everything above drops down.

Three buttons in battle

  1. Attack fills on your hero's name plate and fires on its own when full.
  2. Awakening fills only when you alternate sum-10 and same-number matches. Tap it to score ×2 for 8s.
  3. Skill fills with every match, faster at higher combos. Tap it to fire your hero's own skill.
  4. Pet uses your chosen pet's skill. Each round starts with 2 uses, plus one per pet fruit you pop (up to 4).

Skill fruit and awakening fruit fill their gauges at once. Pop a gear fruit to get that gear.
